name: Iron Leafhead
description: Open with a thrust from the high hawk while the low hawk's stance waits for the answer.

name: Might Bladewings
description: Skim the point just above the ground and jab into the ankle of the advancing foe.

name: Murk Longshaft
description: Spread the hands to the two ends of the shaft and turn aside a heavy chop.

name: Pointglimmer
description: Alternate high and low steps in pairs so the body's height shifts unpredictably.

name: Iron Slideshaft
description: Send a high thrust and a low thrust in the same extension to catch both sides of the guard.

name: Socketdurance
description: Beat the haft sharply against an opposing shaft to draw the eye while the other hawk strikes.

name: Impervious Ferrule
description: Wheel the shaft round the body in a paired swoop that turns away strikes from two sides.

name: Confluent Pushthrough
description: Strike from above and below in one chain, so that every guard raised leaves another opening.

name: Glint Collarband
description: Dive the point down through the guard while the shaft's tail sweeps up to cover the retreat.

name: Hour Buttshoe
description: Press a high strike and a low strike so close together that the opponent can answer neither before both land.

name: Mayhemthrust
description: Flick the tassel into the opponent's eyes so the point's line is lost for a heartbeat.

name: Spearwrath
description: Jab the point through the screen of the spinning tassel to the target's chest.

name: Inexorable Bindcord
description: Sweep the shaft with the tassel's weight to catch a thrust and carry it wide.

name: Iron Bladewings
description: Spin the tassel in a bright cloud before the body to hide the stance.

name: Webbing Stretch
description: Wrap the tassel about an opposing haft and pull the weapon out of line.

name: Rumble Bindcord
description: Hide the point behind the spinning plume and stab through it into the opening.

name: Toxin Buttshoe
description: Wheel the tasselled shaft around an opposing weapon to turn it from its owner's grip.

name: Lot Pushthrough
description: Throw two thrusts through the veil of the tassel in quick succession at different heights.

name: Slag Collarband
description: Hide a flurry of point strikes behind the whirling tassel so every opponent in reach is struck from an unseen line.

name: Equipoise Ferrule
description: Spread the feet wide and drop low so the shaft covers the whole front of the body.

name: Merciless Beatback
description: Sweep the shaft just above the floor to strike both shins of the opponent.

name: Gustspear
description: Roll the weight from one foot to the other like a stone in a stream to cross short distances.

name: Tempered Leafhead
description: Drive the point forward from a low, level stance with the full length of the rear leg.

name: Murk Spearpoint
description: Reset the guard from a crouch with the point held at the opponent's belly height.

name: Thrustwrath
description: Rise from the floor stance into a climbing thrust at the face of the opponent.

name: Torrent Longshaft
description: Slide the opposing blade down the shaft as water slides over stone.

name: Socketnerve
description: Hook the blade behind the opponent's ankle and pull to trip the advancing step.

name: Hourpoint
description: Fill the space around the body with a series of low sweeps and rising thrusts.

name: Stretch Wrath
description: Stamp the lead foot on the ground and send the shock through the haft into the point.

name: Daybreak Heelspike
description: Flood the ground at the spear's reach with sweeps and thrusts that give no room to stand.

name: Wrathful Slideshaft
description: Draw several small streams of qi to the point and thrust as they merge.

name: Twirlwrath
description: Let the shaft run out through the hands as a river runs out into the sea.

name: Equipoise Leafhead
description: Run a parry from one hand into the other like a stream joining its larger river.

name: Ruinous Buttshoe
description: Merge two streams of qi in the shaft and send them out together in a hard drive.

name: Might Beatback
description: Fan three jabs out from one stance like a river delta's mouths at different heights.

name: Spearspine
description: Press the shaft down on an opposing haft with the weight of a silt-laden river.

name: Intent Heelspike
description: Strike twice in one surge, the second blow rising on the first like a tide on a bank.

name: Ferrule Nerve
description: Wheel the shaft in a wide parry that catches blows from every side of the stance.

name: Pointruin
description: Gather every stream of the qi field into the point and loose them in one overwhelming thrust.

name: Devastating Stretch
description: Extend the arms fully along the long track and jab at the edge of the opponent's reach.

name: Eviscerating Slideshaft
description: Step in along the short track and prick the point into the opponent's ribs.

name: Twirlglare
description: Shift from the long track to the short track partway through a step to alter the distance.

name: Torrent Bindcord
description: Roll the shaft from hand to hand across the front to parry along two tracks.

name: Blaze Bladewings
description: Retreat along the long track while jabbing at the closing opponent's lead hand.

name: Lot Spearpoint
description: Alternate thrusts on the long and short tracks so the opponent never settles on a distance.

name: Rumble Longshaft
description: Slide the grip while the point is already moving and land a thrust at an unexpected reach.

name: Collarband Spine
description: Cross from one parry track to the other as a thrust slips past the first.

name: Suffocating Pushthrough
description: Press on the opposing haft along both tracks to pry the weapon from the opponent's hand.

name: Iron Stretch
description: Send the point on the long track and the haft's butt on the short track to strike one target together.

name: Reverberating Longshaft
description: Pour out a string of long and short thrusts that give the opponent no safe distance.

name: Socketwrath
description: Run both tracks of qi through the shaft as one and strike through the opponent's guard to the target beyond.

name: Might Collarband
description: Beat the haft across the opponent's guard like a wing striking the air.

name: Thrustflash
description: Rise on the toes and step forward on the updraft of the swing.

name: Blistering Ferrule
description: Extend the shaft in a long soaring line and thrust at the highest point of the opponent's guard.

name: Twirlscourge
description: Spread the arms to full wingspan and sweep the whole haft through the space before the body.

name: Equipoise Bladewings
description: Parry with the lightest turn of the shaft, using the opponent's own force to carry the blow past.

name: Nova Spearpoint
description: Slide the point over the top of a raised guard and glide it down onto the target.

name: Multiplying Pushthrough
description: Join a rising sweep, a glide and a diving thrust into one soaring combination.

name: Thorn Leafhead
description: Fold the haft tight across the body to receive a strike and spring it open into a counter-thrust.

name: Brutalizing Buttshoe
description: Beat the haft out in a single great wingbeat that strikes every opponent in reach at once.

name: Gnashing Bindcord
description: Draw two lines of attack together and meet them at a single point on the target.

name: Chime Heelspike
description: Hold a stance in which both hands guard along different lines that meet at the point.

name: Gust Beatback
description: Slip into a side channel beside the opponent's thrust and then rejoin the main line behind it.

name: Adamantine Bladewings
description: Join two small parries in one flowing turn that carries the blow far from the body.

name: Rampaging Slideshaft
description: Push two currents of qi along the shaft, joining at the point to drive through a layered guard.

name: Pointvalor
description: Hook with two streams of force in sequence to peel the opposing haft out of its owner's hands.

name: Spearpoint Spine
description: Cross the shaft in a continuous spin so two screens of qi overlap in the front.

name: Iron Ferrule
description: Burst both currents together out of the point at the moment of contact for a hard driving blow.

name: Doctrine Stretch
description: Run two flows of attack down separate lines and unite them in a final blow on one target.

name: Rumble Collarband
description: Fill the point with the full force of two joined rivers of qi and thrust through the guard.

name: Remnant Longshaft
description: Hold the opponent's weapon and the opponent's feet in two points of attention at once.

name: Might Slideshaft
description: Choose one of two openings in the opponent's stance and thrust at it without hesitation.

name: Might Pushthrough
description: Weave the feet in pairs of short steps that keep the stance level over broken ground.

name: Bindcord Spine
description: Cross the shaft over the body in a guard that covers two lines at once.

name: Granite Beatback
description: Strike one opening and, as the guard answers it, strike the other with the same hand.

name: Immobilizing Heelspike
description: Mirror the opponent's beat on the haft and return it to unsettle the opponent's grip.

name: Hogtying Leafhead
description: Press the shaft against two opposing lines of motion until both lose force.

name: Hourspear
description: Pierce the opponent's lead hand and then the knee in one flowing combination.

name: Buttshoe Nerve
description: Cover two sides of the body with the shaft in a paired shield of spinning qi.

name: Glint Stretch
description: Send two lines of qi through the point so the strike lands at two places on one body.

name: Blaze Bindcord
description: Thrust after a long march with the body settled and the point held without tremor.

name: Gust Buttshoe
description: Stand with the chest to the wind and the shaft angled to meet the oncoming blow.

name: Gust Leafhead
description: Run a long stride over open ground and set the point at the end of it.

name: Glintsocket
description: Drive a jab with the force of a gust gathered in the rear leg.

name: Thrustmettle
description: Advance in a pressing walk with the shaft held out so the opponent cannot step across the line.

name: Gust Collarband
description: Sweep an incoming strike off the stance at the edge of the guard and return the point at once.

name: Novaspear
description: Rush with the wind at the back and drive the point home with the body's whole speed.

name: Pointwrath
description: Hold the stance and fan out three thrusts at different heights without ever moving the feet.

name: Thrustruin
description: Stake the whole body's qi on a single thrust that breaks open the opponent's held line.

name: Hellish Ferrule
description: Swear the line aloud in the mind and jab along it with the lead hand.

name: Murk Heelspike
description: Draw the shaft back at gale speed so the answering strike meets only the haft.

name: Silt Beatback
description: Slide forward under the press of the wind at the back and settle the weight.

name: Facetsocket
description: Run the thrust through to its end and let the gust of the stride bear the point home.

name: Gyvetwirl
description: Hold the oath-line against an opposing shaft and hold the bind until the opponent yields.

name: Evergreen Longshaft
description: Let the shaft hang from the lead hand and turn it in the wind to tear blows from their line.

name: Synchronized Slideshaft
description: Chase the opponent in a series of thrusts that each fulfil the oath of the last.

name: Decimating Pushthrough
description: Sweep the leaf-blade's edge through a gust of qi so every opponent in reach is cut.

name: Titanic Iron Spearpoint
description: Gather the whole of the oath into one final thrust that drives through the guard as a gale through a thicket.

name: Spearscourge
description: Hold the point on a true bearing from the first step to the last in a single thrust.

name: Waning Spearpoint
description: Pause between steps to take the opponent's bearing and set the point upon it.

name: Chime Bladewings
description: Set the feet by the slope of the ground so the guard does not shift under a blow.

name: Murk Leafhead
description: Parry a thrust on a slant that crosses its bearing and turns it away.

name: Mangling Spearpoint
description: Shift the bearing by a hand at the last moment and pierce the guard turned to the old line.

name: Enthralling Bladewings
description: Hold the line against a charge and wedge the shaft between the opponent's hands.

name: Pointdurance
description: Press along a fixed bearing so the opponent's weapon is forced from its line.

name: Doctrine Ferrule
description: Chain thrusts on three bearings in turn to wear a guard down at each angle.

name: Glint Beatback
description: Split a thick guard by driving the point down a bearing the opponent has not covered.

name: Twirlruin
description: Let nothing shake the bearing and drive the point through guard, armour and shield on a single sure line.

name: Ferocious Stretch
description: Thrust along a narrow ledge with one foot placed before the other and the shaft level.

name: Gust Longshaft
description: Slide along a ridge with the weight low and the point held to the open side.

name: Chime Bindcord
description: Hold the guard with the shaft angled to the drop and turn aside a push.

name: Flintlike Buttshoe
description: Brace the shaft against the ground and the body so a shove cannot move the stance.

name: Socketruin
description: Prick the point at the opponent's lead foot while the wind pushes the other way.

name: Turning Slideshaft
description: Lunge, pivot on the edge and thrust back into the opponent who followed.

name: Chime Pushthrough
description: Drive the shoulder and haft into the opponent at the ledge and unbalance the stance.

name: Thornthrust
description: Hook the blade behind the opponent's lead leg to pull it toward the drop.

name: Overlapping Collarband
description: Strike in a cascade of thrusts and steps along the ridge, each landing a pace further on.

name: Charter Heelspike
description: Wrap the stance in a spinning cloak of qi and wind that turns every strike at the edge.

name: Corroding Twirl Reckoning
description: Throw the whole body's weight forward into a single thrust that no opponent at the ledge's edge can answer.

name: Tempered Buttshoe
description: Thrust on level ground with the point aimed at the horizon and the whole body behind it.

name: Stretch Slipstream
description: Glide along the line of the wind with the weight forward and the point leading.

name: Gust Ferrule
description: Stand with no cover and parry with the shaft alone, trusting the footing.

name: Spearruin
description: Slant the shaft through the gust and strike the target's arm at the angle the wind favours.

name: Rumble Heelspike
description: Beat the haft across the line of the opponent's weapon and hold it open for the point.

name: Booming Slideshaft
description: Rake the shaft across the front in a sweeping press that the wind carries wide.

name: Novatwirl
description: Charge along the line of the long wind and thrust through the target's guard as the gust drives.

name: Slag Pushthrough
description: Whirl the shaft in a wind-driven circle that scatters all within reach on open ground.

name: Berserk Beatback Scourge
description: Pour the whole wind's force into the point and drive it through the target in one unobstructed line.

name: Chime Leafhead
description: Hold the haft across the wind and let it turn a blow aside as a lever.

name: Ironsocket
description: Wait for a gust to open the opponent's guard and thrust through the gap.

name: Feeling Bladewings
description: Lean into the wind and feel by its press on the shaft where the opponent stands.

name: Pointhavoc
description: Hold the high ground and jab the point down at the target below.

name: Beatback Glare
description: Slip sideways across a gust to be off the line when the attack lands.

name: Collarband Fortitude
description: Lever the haft against a heavy weapon's swing and send it out of line.

name: Escalating Longshaft
description: Chain two thrusts with the wind at the back, the second striking as the first withdraws.

name: Overbearing Bindcord
description: Pin the opponent's weapon to the ground with the point and hold it in the wind.

name: Might Spearpoint
description: Spin against the wind to swing the haft hard across an opponent closing in.

name: Unsparing Ferrule
description: Drive the haft's weight and the gale's push through the point onto a braced guard.

name: Granite Twirl
description: Scour the ground before the stance with one wide sweep that clears all opponents within reach.

name: Overlapping Stretch
description: Finish an exchange with a series of sworn thrusts each cutting across the wind from a new line.

name: Longshaft Wrath
description: Cut across the wind with a thrust that pierces the guard and drives on beyond it.

name: Sanguine Buttshoe
description: Fix the purpose in mind and thrust with the point held steady throughout.

name: Equipoise Spearpoint
description: Parry in the manner the oath prescribes, with the shaft held as the wind teaches.

name: Torrent Bladewings
description: March at a pace the oath sets, with the point held low and ready.

name: Thrustscourge
description: Sustain a thrust through to the end with the oath guiding the arms until the point lands.

name: Thorntwirl
description: Beat and hold the opposing haft along the sworn line until it submits.

name: Hoursocket
description: Fan thrusts across the front in the rhythm of an oath spoken at the pace of the wind.

name: Glintspear
description: Fulfil the oath with a diving thrust that carries the body's weight onto the point.

name: Thorn Heelspike
description: Hold the oath in a standing whirl of the shaft that makes the stance unbroken against a rush.

name: Pointscourge
description: Carry the whole oath on a single thrust so the point lands with the weight of a sworn promise behind it.

name: Vengeful Thrust
description: Gather speed in the shaft from the rear hand to the point and thrust upward at the throat.

name: Silt Slideshaft
description: Step wide to gather the wind into the cloth and the stance before a thrust.

name: Verity Leafhead
description: Hold the point steady in the gale and feel the opponent's guard through the shaft.

name: Murk Bindcord
description: Turn the haft into the wind so a blow is carried off the stance.

name: Shattering Pushthrough
description: Close low on the windstep and jab at the thigh before the guard can fall.

name: Thrusthavoc
description: Run the shaft out through the hands in a single gathering stroke that grows faster toward the point.

name: Beatback Valor
description: Bind the opposing haft with a hook that the wind makes hard to shake.

name: Aegis Collarband
description: Catch a blow on the windward side of the shaft and let the gust turn it.

name: Sockethavoc
description: Fall onto the opposing guard along the bound line with the wind's full push.

name: Beatback Ruin
description: Thrust with the gale gathered in the point so it lands with a roaring burst on a braced guard.

name: Collarband Devastation
description: Hound the retreating opponent with thrusts, each carried a pace further on the wind.

name: Grievous Tempered Heelspike
description: Bind the whole gale to the point and thrust so that wind and weapon strike as one.
